reference: The carrot in the bed is unbelievably big.
sk: Mrkva v záhone je neuveriteľne veľká.
cz: Mrkev v záhonu je neuvěřitelně velká.
acceptable: The carrot in the {bed|garden bed|vegetable bed|vegetable patch} is {unbelievably|incredibly} {big|large}.

mistakes.text: The carrot in the bed unbelievably big.
The carrot in the bed are unbelievably big.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Mrkva je jedna, preto patrí „is“, nie „are“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Mrkev je jedna, proto sem patří „is“, ne „are“.

mistakes.text: The carrot is in the bed unbelievably big.
The carrot on the bed is unbelievably big.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V záhone je „in the bed“, nie „on the bed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V záhonu je „in the bed“, ne „on the bed“.

mistakes.text: Carrot in the bed is unbelievably big.
